title: Viola seed logarithmic bound
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $d$ and a real number $\varepsilon$, define the Viola seed logarithmic bound to be $d\bigl(4+2(\log_2 n+2^{d-1}\log_2(9/\varepsilon))\bigr)$, where $d-1$ in the exponent is natural-number subtraction.
